changelog.notes: Schema 2.0. Block renamed to site. Harmonised variable names, units and English descriptions. Country and crop added to site data. Administrative names kept as adm1 to adm3. Coordinates checked against country borders.

study.title: Ghana cowpea tricot trial 2024
study.description: This project seeks to identify best performing cowpea genotypes under farmers field.

location_privacy.method: Site coordinates rounded to two decimals (a cell of about 1.1 km), so the published point lies within 800 m of the recorded one and neighbouring sites share a point.
location_privacy.admin_names: Administrative names kept as adm1 to adm3, capitalisation standardised

data_producer.name: CSIR-Savanna Agricultural Research Institute (CSIR-SARI)
data_producer.attribution: inferred from the project code, title and the tricot partner network (confidence high): title or PI (Theophilus Tengey: CSIR-SARI breeder); 21GNGHOF01 title says CSIR-SARI

genotypes.target_trait: Large seed size and stable yield
Aphid resistant, resistant to striga and tolerance to drought
Early maturing with unique brown seed coat colour
